world_rules.monster_loot_roll_success: Base eligible harvest chance is context dependent; no global percentage fixed. If harvest is successful, use per-monster weights to choose one material.
world_rules.defeat_vs_harvest: Defeating does not guarantee physical loot. Recovered resources can be lost to fire, water or destroyed bodies.
world_rules.books: Books may be found intact or as clues, subject to source rules and local restrictions; no automatic skill or circle rank.
world_rules.equipment: Optional entries are candidate IDs and must meet scenario and level/rarity requirements.
world_rules.unique_epic: Unique/epic gear never granted by generic dungeon tables; explicit exceptional quest or world event only.
world_rules.repeat_claims: Save persistent clear IDs; rewards applied exactly once. Replay visuals never grants second items.
world_rules.secret: No GM-only secrets exposed to loot tables.
